scope.basis: connected_p1, the basis of the paper
scope.alpha: fixed 1000.0 from config.json; no weight search

partition.rule: sites = cell_complex.sites_of(case, case_loader.select_records(case, 'pub')) - the paper site rule applied to EVERY window record (all frames, all particles). This is the published site set.
partition.reads: frame ids, particle ids and record coordinates only; reads no velocity, no reference field and no error metric
partition.assertion: the built partition's n_cells MUST equal expected_N_c for that case; a mismatch is a hard failure of gate D_part with no substitution.
partition.complex: cell_complex.build: pore_ownership.exact_owners ownership, paper cell order, sorted (lo, hi) edges, connected_p1 trace; checks wrap_same == 0, max cell x-extent < L/2, each site owns its cell

arms.PN: pure FV (alpha = 0; observations.assisted_operator returns the forward A and b objects) on the published partition. Same configuration as Table 5.
arms.AN: assisted FV (alpha = 1000) on the SAME published partition, selector S-A = observations.nearest_centroid_selection over case_loader.select_records(case, 'pub'): in each cell the record nearest the cell volume centroid (Euclidean, minimum image in x), ties to the lower CSV row. Exactly one record per cell is asserted. N_obs = N_cells. Particles are NOT required to be distinct: one particle may supply the record of several cells, and that is recorded, not prevented.
arms.MN: assisted FV (alpha = 1000) on the SAME published partition, selector S-M = EVERY window record, with no per-cell reduction. N_obs = number of records (expected_records below). A cell receives as many observation triples as it owns records; the count per cell is recorded. Every record's voxel must have an owner cell (hard failure otherwise).

expected_records_no_solve.note: record counts are read from the window CSVs by case_loader and involve no solve; they are stated here so a mismatch is detectable
expected_records_no_solve.others: not stated in advance; recorded and reported as read

assisted_problem.objective: min 0.5 z'Az - b'z + (gamma*w/2)||Hz - y||^2 subject to Dz = 0, solved as the reduced KKT system, identical to observations.assisted_operator
assisted_problem.H: velocity_recovery.point_operator(xyz, owners, trace, R, G): the first-order affine reconstruction R row + G (x - c) evaluated at each record's continuous position, minimum image in x.
assisted_problem.gamma: observations.gamma_of(case, trace, alpha) = alpha * nu * sum_i V_i / (mask.size * h^3)^(2/3); the value is recorded.
assisted_problem.weight: w = 1 / N_obs for both AN and MN. Consequence: the total data-term weight gamma*w*||Hz-y||^2 is held comparable across arms while the per-observation weight falls as observations grow, so MN does NOT simply apply 15x more penalty than AN. The alternative normalisation (fixed per-observation weight) is not evaluated here.
assisted_problem.alpha_status: fixed at 1000.0; no weight search; no sensitivity experiment in this protocol

solver.method: single-threaded CPU MINRES; OMP_NUM_THREADS = OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = MKL_NUM_THREADS = 1, recorded
solver.residual_gate: recomputed KKT relative residual of the system actually solved must be <= 1e-12

readouts.e_ff: full-field voxel velocity error, a fraction not a percent
readouts.leave_out_check: for AN and MN, e_ff is ALSO recomputed with the directly observed voxels excluded from the error norm, and both values are reported.
readouts.naive_baseline: for AN and MN, the volume-weighted mean of the observed velocities is formed with no solve at all and its eK_arch_s is reported beside the arm's, using pore_ownership.exact_owners ownership.

gates.D_int: code and input sha256 match the run record; protocol sha256 recorded
gates.D_part: cell_complex partition checks pass AND n_cells == expected_N_c for the case
gates.D_basis: connected_p1 trace built, trace mode count recorded
gates.D_obs: AN: exactly one record per cell. MN: every record owned, per-cell counts recorded. Both: point-operator defect (observations.point_operator_defect) <= 1e-10
gates.D_solver: recomputed KKT relative residual <= 1e-12 for all three arms
gates.D_readout: recorded readouts equal locally recomputed readouts within 1e-10 * max(1, |value|)
gates.D_pure_matches_E0: PN's eK_arch_s, eK_flux_s, e_phi and e_u_cell must reproduce the Table 5 values stored in the case's run_record.json (row) to the printed precision. This is an external anchor that the published-partition path is built correctly; a mismatch is a hard failure.

notes: the observations are noise-free samples of the reference field at the record positions; they carry no independent information
the assisted solution does not solve the Stokes momentum equation; its plain-Stokes momentum relative residual is reported for every assisted arm
